items.docs:
Retrieves a list of all subscription offerings.

### Filtering

This endpoint supports filtering. For the general syntax, see [**Filtering**](/guides/Getting-Started/filtering).

The following attributes and operators are supported.

| Operator | Attribute | Description |

info.name: Build an offering

items.docs:
An offering includes plans and pricing options; plans are combined with one or more pricing options to form an offering. An offering can include either:

- subscription plans (created within an offering).
- Product Experience Manager products. See [**create a product**](/docs/api/pxm/products/create-product).

When you are building an offering:

- you can create new pricing options and plans.
- you can modify an existing plan and pricing options. For example, you can modify the plan price or any

info.name: Update an offering

params.name: offering_uuid
params.description: The unique identifier of the offering.

items.docs: After saving an offering, you can update an offering at any time. Updating an offering does not affect any active subscriptions. The changes take effect on all new subscriptions that are created. For fields that are optional, an existing value can be removed by specifying a value of null.
